about: Outside adds through a creature_formations link: Utgarde Keep formation 126032 (groupAI 5, members assist leader and each other) is split into two clusters 33-35yd apart: Dragonflayer Strategist 126032 + 23960 126041 in the west hall (221,200), and 23960 126042 + 23961 126046 at (197-208,226-231). Tagging either half engages the whole formation from its spawn spots (CreatureGroup::MemberEngagingTarget), so the far half always joins. The formation-aware classify (427e0f7d) predicts it: tr-20260922-192744-29#9, tr-20260922-194518-38#13 and three sibling snapshots show pred 4-5 / obs 4-5 with 126042/126046 joining from outside the target cluster. O7 attributes the far half as outside joiners for the report (outsideMax -1); the pass/fail check is engaged vs predicted. A formation-blind classifier predicts 2 against 4 engaged and fails it. Start = the real tank position of tr-20260922-192744-29#9, 53yd from 126032. History: this entry used Shattered Halls formation 151019 until lb-20261003-155828-1; those five spawns carry guid SAI 'On Respawn - Disable' (actionlist 10: invisible + IMMUNE_TO_PC/NPC) that only a gauntlet counter re-enables, so after Lab staging they could never be pulled (0/2 killed, timeout, both runs). Every split formation on map 540 is gated the same way. Memory: ac-formation-assist-links-packs.
